title: Held Waiting-List Seats and Cancellation Refunds: Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule
content:
A held-seat charge on a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit is never refunded when the family cancels. A held-seat charge is the months billed for a seat offered from the waiting list and held before the family accepted it; it is taken out of the net fee before the credited share is applied. The seat was offered on the assignment's stop assignment date.

| Offer compared with the fee's posting | Held months the fee carries |
|---|---|
| offered in an earlier calendar month than the month the fee posted, and the fee posted more than 10 calendar days after the offer | one held month (1) |
| offered in an earlier calendar month, and the fee posted 6 to 10 calendar days after the offer | half a held month (0.5) |
| any other case, or no stop is assigned | none |

**Held-seat charge.** The fee less its late application charge, if any, times the held months divided by the months the fee covers plus the held months.

## Both sides (hypothetical)

| Seat offered | Fee posted | Days after the offer | Held months |
|---|---|---|---|
| November 24 | December 5 | 11 | 1 |
| November 24 | December 4 | 10 | 0.5 |
| November 24 | November 30 | 6 | none (same calendar month) |
| November 27 | December 2 | 5 | none |

## Example (hypothetical)

A school-year fee of 154.00 USD, no late application charge, covering 6 months and carrying half a held month: the held-seat charge is 154.00 times 0.5 divided by 6.5, 11.8462, taken out of the net fee.
